<!-- Summary:
Across the league, a heavier training load is associated with a much higher chance of injury for
older players but not for younger ones. For a 30-year-old, each extra level of training load
multiplies the odds of injury by about 2.2 (95% CI 1.5 to 3.0), while for players in their early
twenties there is no evidence of any effect. Each previous injury multiplies the odds by about 1.7.
-->

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.pos = "!htb", fig.align = "center", out.width = "100%")

# Helper functions
fmt_p  <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p))
pct    <- function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * x)
f2     <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)
ci_txt <- function(l, u, f = f2) paste0(f(l), "--", f(u))
inv_logit <- function(eta) 1 / (1 + exp(-eta))
```

```{r data}
# Read and prepare player data
players <- read.csv("league_players.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

# Centre age at 25 and training load at 3 so that main effects refer to a typical player
players$age_c     <- players$age - 25
players$load_c    <- players$training_load - 3
players$matches90 <- players$minutes_played / 90   # minutes rescaled to full-match equivalents

# Bands used only for exploratory plots and model checking (not in the model itself)
players$age_band  <- cut(players$age, breaks = c(16, 24, 28, 40),
                         labels = c("17-24", "25-28", "29+"))
players$load_band <- factor(ifelse(players$training_load <= 2, "1-2", players$training_load),
                            levels = c("1-2", "3", "4", "5"))

n_players <- nrow(players)
n_inj     <- sum(players$injured)
```

```{r eda, include = FALSE}
# Further EDA summary
summary(players)
prop_al <- with(players, tapply(injured, list(age_band, load_band), mean))
n_al    <- with(players, table(age_band, load_band))
prop_al; n_al

pos_rate <- with(players, tapply(injured, position, mean))
pos_rate
with(players, tapply(injured, prev_injuries, mean))
with(players, tapply(injured, cut(bmi, quantile(bmi), include.lowest = TRUE), mean))
with(players, tapply(injured, cut(matches90, quantile(matches90), include.lowest = TRUE), mean))
with(players, tapply(injured, team, mean))

cor_mat <- cor(players[, c("age", "minutes_played", "training_load", "prev_injuries", "bmi")])
round(cor_mat, 2)
cor_max <- max(abs(cor_mat[upper.tri(cor_mat)]))

# Observed (empirical) log-odds of injury by number of previous injuries
y_prev <- tapply(players$injured, players$prev_injuries, sum)
n_prev <- tapply(players$injured, players$prev_injuries, length)
elogit_prev <- log((y_prev + 0.5) / (n_prev - y_prev + 0.5))
```

## Example Question:

**Is a player's chance of being injured during the season associated with their weekly training load, and does that association depend on the player's age, once injury history and other player characteristics are allowed for?**

Injuries are costly to the club, and training load is the one variable here that Ashford directly controls. A finding about who is more likely to be vulnerable to heavy training is therefore a useful insight. Ashford's own squad (25 players, 4 injuries) is too small to model reliably, so we used all `r n_players` players in the league and then applied the fitted model to Ashford's squad.



```{r fig1, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 2.6, fig.cap = "(a) Observed proportion injured by training load and age group (loads 1 and 2 combined because few players train at load 1). (b) Observed log-odds of injury, $\\log\\{(y+0.5)/(n-y+0.5)\\}$, by number of previous injuries; $n$ is the number of players."}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 1.2, 0.5), cex = 0.75)
cols_age <- c("grey55", "steelblue", "firebrick")
matplot(1:4, t(prop_al), type = "b", pch = 15:17, lty = 1, lwd = 1.5, col = cols_age,
        xaxt = "n", ylim = c(0, 0.7), xlab = "Training load", ylab = "Proportion injured")
axis(1, at = 1:4, labels = levels(players$load_band))
legend("topleft", legend = paste("Age", levels(players$age_band)), col = cols_age,
       pch = 15:17, lty = 1, bty = "n")
mtext("(a)", side = 3, adj = 0, line = 0.2)
plot(0:4, elogit_prev, type = "b", pch = 19, ylim = c(-2.5, 0),
     xlab = "Previous injuries (last three seasons)", ylab = "Observed log-odds of injury")
text(0:4, elogit_prev, paste0("n=", n_prev), pos = 4, cex = 0.8)
mtext("(b)", side = 3, adj = 0, line = 0.2)
```



## Model selection

```{r models, include = FALSE}
# Start from all player-level covariates; backward elimination with drop1
m0 <- glm(injured ~ 1, family = binomial, data = players)
m1 <- glm(injured ~ position + age_c + matches90 + load_c + prev_injuries + bmi,
          family = binomial, data = players)
summary(m1)
drop1(m1, test = "Chisq")          # matches90 least useful -> remove
m2 <- update(m1, . ~ . - matches90)
drop1(m2, test = "Chisq")          # bmi least useful -> remove
m3 <- update(m2, . ~ . - bmi)
drop1(m3, test = "Chisq")          # position not significant -> remove
m4 <- update(m3, . ~ . - position)
drop1(m4, test = "Chisq")          # all remaining terms significant
summary(m4)

# Check functional form and club on the main-effects model
c_loadF <- update(m4, . ~ . - load_c + factor(training_load))         # load as 5-level factor
c_prevF <- update(m4, . ~ . - prev_injuries + factor(prev_injuries))  # prev. injuries as factor
c_age2  <- update(m4, . ~ . + I(age_c^2))                             # curvature in age
c_club  <- update(m4, . ~ . + team)                                   # club differences

# Interactions among the retained terms
m4_int2 <- update(m4, . ~ .^2)     # all two-way interactions
anova(m4, m4_int2, test = "Chisq")
drop1(m4_int2, test = "Chisq")     # age_c:load_c is the important one
m5 <- glm(injured ~ age_c * load_c + prev_injuries, family = binomial, data = players)

# Confirm nothing else is needed given M5
c5_lp   <- update(m5, . ~ . + load_c:prev_injuries)
c5_ap   <- update(m5, . ~ . + age_c:prev_injuries)
c5_old  <- update(m5, . ~ . + position + bmi + matches90)   # re-add the dropped terms
c5_club <- update(m5, . ~ . + team)
summary(m5)
```

```{r table1-build, include = FALSE}
# Build the model-selection (decisions) table
lr <- function(small, big) {
  a <- anova(small, big, test = "Chisq")
  c(a$Deviance[2], a$Df[2], a$`Pr(>Chi)`[2])
}
mods <- list(M0 = m0, M1 = m1, M2 = m2, M3 = m3, M4 = m4, loadF = c_loadF, prevF = c_prevF,
             age2 = c_age2, club = c_club, M5 = m5, lp = c5_lp, ap = c5_ap, old = c5_old,
             club5 = c5_club)
tests <- rbind(c(NA, NA, NA), lr(m0, m1), lr(m2, m1), lr(m3, m2), lr(m4, m3),
               lr(m4, c_loadF), lr(m4, c_prevF), lr(m4, c_age2), lr(m4, c_club),
               lr(m4, m5), lr(m5, c5_lp), lr(m5, c5_ap), lr(m5, c5_old), lr(m5, c5_club))
colnames(tests) <- c("LR", "df", "p")
rownames(tests) <- names(mods)

labels <- c("M0: intercept only",
            "M1: position + age + minutes + load + prev. inj. + BMI",
            "M2: M1 $-$ minutes", "M3: M2 $-$ BMI", "M4: M3 $-$ position",
            "M4, load as 5-level factor", "M4, prev. injuries as factor",
            "M4 + age$^2$", "M4 + club (23 df)",
            "**M5: M4 + age $\\times$ load**",
            "M5 + load $\\times$ prev. inj.", "M5 + age $\\times$ prev. inj.",
            "M5 + position, BMI, minutes", "M5 + club (23 df)")
compared <- c("", "M0", "M1", "M2", "M3", "M4", "M4", "M4", "M4", "M4", "M5", "M5", "M5", "M5")
decision <- c("", "Start", "Drop", "Drop", "Drop", "Keep linear", "Keep linear", "Not needed",
              "Not needed", "**Add**", "Not added$^\\dagger$", "Not added", "Not needed",
              "Not needed")
tab1 <- data.frame(
  Model       = labels,
  `Resid. dev.` = sprintf("%.1f", sapply(mods, deviance)),
  df          = sapply(mods, df.residual),
  AIC         = sprintf("%.1f", sapply(mods, AIC)),
  `vs`        = compared,
  `LRT (df)`  = ifelse(is.na(tests[, "LR"]), "",
                       sprintf("%.2f (%d)", tests[, "LR"], as.integer(tests[, "df"]))),
  p           = ifelse(is.na(tests[, "p"]), "", fmt_p(tests[, "p"])),
  Decision    = decision,
  check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
```

\begingroup\small

```{r table1}
knitr::kable(tab1, align = "lrrrcrrl",
             caption = "Model-selection path. Each LRT compares the model in that row with the model named in the vs column. The final model is in bold.")
```

\endgroup

## Results

```{r results-build, include = FALSE}
# Final model: estimates, Wald 95% CIs, odds ratios
cs <- coef(summary(m5))
ci <- confint.default(m5)           # Wald intervals: estimate +/- 1.96 SE
exp(cbind(OR = coef(m5), ci))

# Linear combination w'beta with SE from vcov(), for effects that depend on the interaction
lin_comb <- function(w, model = m5) {
  b <- coef(model); V <- vcov(model)
  w_full <- setNames(rep(0, length(b)), names(b)); w_full[names(w)] <- w
  est <- sum(w_full * b)
  se  <- sqrt(drop(t(w_full) %*% V %*% w_full))
  c(est = est, se = se, OR = exp(est), lower = exp(est - 1.96 * se),
    upper = exp(est + 1.96 * se), p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(est / se)))
}
load_or <- function(age)  lin_comb(c(load_c = 1, "age_c:load_c" = age - 25))   # +1 load level
age5_or <- function(load) lin_comb(c(age_c = 5, "age_c:load_c" = 5 * (load - 3)))  # +5 years

# Predicted probability with 95% CI (computed on the logit scale, then transformed)
pred_prob <- function(age, load, prev = 0, model = m5) {
  nd <- data.frame(age_c = age - 25, load_c = load - 3, prev_injuries = prev)
  pr <- predict(model, newdata = nd, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE)
  data.frame(age = age, load = load, prev = prev, fit = inv_logit(pr$fit),
             lower = inv_logit(pr$fit - 1.96 * pr$se.fit),
             upper = inv_logit(pr$fit + 1.96 * pr$se.fit))
}

ages_der <- c(20, 30, 33)
der <- t(sapply(ages_der, load_or))
lo20 <- load_or(20); lo25 <- load_or(25); lo30 <- load_or(30); lo33 <- load_or(33)
a5_3 <- age5_or(3);  a5_5 <- age5_or(5)
age_zero <- 25 - coef(m5)["load_c"] / coef(m5)["age_c:load_c"]   # age where load effect = 0
pp30 <- pred_prob(30, c(3, 5)); pp20 <- pred_prob(20, c(3, 5))

tab2 <- data.frame(
  Term = c("Intercept (odds for age 25, load 3, no prev. injuries)",
           "Age (per year), at load 3", "Training load (per level), at age 25",
           "Previous injuries (per injury)", "Age $\\times$ load",
           paste0("*Derived:* training load (per level), at age ", ages_der)),
  `Estimate (SE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", c(cs[, 1], der[, "est"]), c(cs[, 2], der[, "se"])),
  `exp(estimate)` = f2(c(exp(cs[, 1]), der[, "OR"])),
  `95% CI` = ci_txt(c(exp(ci[, 1]), der[, "lower"]), c(exp(ci[, 2]), der[, "upper"])),
  p = fmt_p(c(cs[, 4], der[, "p"])),
  check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL)

# Apply the model to Ashford's squad
players$fit <- fitted(m5)
ash      <- players[players$team == "Ashford United", ]
ash_obs  <- sum(ash$injured)
ash_exp  <- sum(ash$fit)
ash_old  <- ash[ash$age >= 29, ]
top      <- ash[which.max(ash$fit), ]
top_now  <- pred_prob(top$age, top$training_load, top$prev_injuries)
top_up   <- pred_prob(top$age, top$training_load + 1, top$prev_injuries)
pos_names <- c(GK = "goalkeeper", DEF = "defender", MID = "midfielder", FWD = "forward")
ash[order(-ash$fit), c("position", "age", "training_load", "prev_injuries", "injured", "fit")]
```

The final model is
$$\text{logit}(\hat\pi) = `r f2(coef(m5)[1])` + `r sprintf("%.3f", coef(m5)[2])`\,(\text{age}-25) + `r sprintf("%.3f", coef(m5)[3])`\,(\text{load}-3) + `r sprintf("%.3f", coef(m5)[4])`\,\text{prev.inj} + `r sprintf("%.3f", coef(m5)[5])`\,(\text{age}-25)(\text{load}-3).$$



\begingroup\small

```{r table2}
knitr::kable(tab2, align = "lrrrr",
             caption = "Final model M5: log-odds estimates with Wald 95% confidence intervals, back-transformed to odds ratios (the intercept row gives baseline odds). The derived rows combine the load and interaction terms using the estimated covariance matrix.")
```

\endgroup

```{r fig2, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 2.6, fig.cap = "Predicted probability of injury against training load at four ages, for players with no previous injuries (left) and two previous injuries (right). Shaded bands are pointwise 95\\% confidence intervals."}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 1.2, 0.5), cex = 0.75)
grid_load <- seq(1, 5, by = 0.1)
ages_plot <- c(20, 25, 30, 33)
cols_pred <- c("grey45", "darkgreen", "steelblue", "firebrick")
for (pv in c(0, 2)) {
  plot(NA, xlim = c(1, 5), ylim = c(0, 1), xlab = "Training load",
       ylab = "Predicted P(injury)")
  for (k in seq_along(ages_plot)) {
    pp <- pred_prob(ages_plot[k], grid_load, prev = pv)
    polygon(c(grid_load, rev(grid_load)), c(pp$lower, rev(pp$upper)),
            col = adjustcolor(cols_pred[k], alpha.f = 0.18), border = NA)
    lines(grid_load, pp$fit, col = cols_pred[k], lwd = 2)
  }
  legend("topleft", legend = paste("Age", ages_plot), col = cols_pred, lwd = 2, bty = "n")
  mtext(paste0(c("(a)", "(b)")[pv / 2 + 1], " ", pv, " previous injuries"),
        side = 3, adj = 0, line = 0.2)
}
```

## Model fit and diagnostics

```{r diagnostics-build, include = FALSE}
# ---- Group players with identical covariate patterns (binary residuals are uninformative) ----
players$one <- 1
grp <- aggregate(cbind(injured, one) ~ age + training_load + prev_injuries,
                 data = players, FUN = sum)
names(grp)[names(grp) == "one"] <- "n"
grp$age_c  <- grp$age - 25
grp$load_c <- grp$training_load - 3
m5g <- glm(cbind(injured, n - injured) ~ age_c * load_c + prev_injuries,
           family = binomial, data = grp)
max(abs(coef(m5g) - coef(m5)))     # same estimates as the ungrouped fit

G      <- nrow(grp); p_par <- length(coef(m5g))
dev_g  <- deviance(m5g); df_g <- df.residual(m5g)
gof_p  <- 1 - pchisq(dev_g, df_g)                                   # deviance goodness of fit
phi    <- sum(residuals(m5g, type = "pearson")^2) / df_g            # dispersion estimate
rs     <- rstandard(m5g)                                            # standardised deviance residuals
lev    <- hatvalues(m5g)
cd     <- cooks.distance(m5g)
cook_thr <- 8 / (G - 2 * p_par)
lev_thr  <- 2 * p_par / G
c(n_rs2 = sum(abs(rs) > 2), n_rs3 = sum(abs(rs) > 3), n_lev = sum(lev > lev_thr),
  n_cook = sum(cd > cook_thr))
grp[order(-cd)[1:5], ]

# ---- Sensitivity: refit without the two most influential covariate patterns ----
top2      <- order(cd, decreasing = TRUE)[1:2]
m5g_drop  <- update(m5g, data = grp[-top2, ])
cbind(full = coef(m5g), without_top2 = coef(m5g_drop))

# ---- Observed vs expected injuries in the age-band x load-band cells of Figure 1(a) ----
obs_cell <- with(players, tapply(injured, list(age_band, load_band), sum))
exp_cell <- with(players, tapply(fit, list(age_band, load_band), sum))
var_cell <- with(players, tapply(fit * (1 - fit), list(age_band, load_band), sum))
z_cell   <- (obs_cell - exp_cell) / sqrt(var_cell)
round(cbind(obs_cell, exp_cell), 1); round(z_cell, 2)
```



```{r fig3, fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 2.3, fig.cap = "Diagnostics for M5 fitted to grouped covariate patterns: (a) standardised deviance residuals against fitted probability; (b) normal QQ-plot; (c) Cook's distances with the $8/(n-2p)$ guideline (dashed); (d) observed against expected injuries in the 12 age $\\times$ load cells of Figure 1(a)."}
par(mfrow = c(1, 4), mar = c(4, 4, 1.2, 0.4), cex = 0.62)
plot(fitted(m5g), rs, pch = 19, col = adjustcolor("black", 0.45),
     xlab = "Fitted probability", ylab = "Std. deviance residual")
abline(h = c(-2, 0, 2), lty = c(2, 1, 2), col = "grey50")
mtext("(a)", side = 3, adj = 0, line = 0.2)
qqnorm(rs, main = "", pch = 19, col = adjustcolor("black", 0.45)); qqline(rs)
mtext("(b)", side = 3, adj = 0, line = 0.2)
plot(cd, type = "h", xlab = "Covariate pattern", ylab = "Cook's distance")
abline(h = cook_thr, lty = 2, col = "firebrick")
mtext("(c)", side = 3, adj = 0, line = 0.2)
plot(as.vector(exp_cell), as.vector(obs_cell), pch = 19, xlab = "Expected injuries",
     ylab = "Observed injuries", xlim = c(0, 26), ylim = c(0, 26))
abline(0, 1, lty = 2)
mtext("(d)", side = 3, adj = 0, line = 0.2)
```
